strings.discEntrySub: 'Recording → speech recognition → optional model processing → typed into your PC'
strings.discLead: 'This page spells out who is in the path between the microphone on this phone and the text box on your computer. Each hop is decided by the engine you chose; the program never substitutes another one for you.'
strings.discOpenFailed: 'Could not open this page. Copy the address and open it in a browser.'
strings.discScopeNote: 'This describes the hosted FlowMic service. If you run everything yourself, none of your data reaches us.'
strings.discStep1Body: 'While you hold the talk button, this phone streams audio and never writes it to our database. See the official site.'
strings.discStep2Body: 'Which engine hears you is a visible setting: the one named for this language, then the catch-all, then the platform default, then the two engine routes we seeded for you at first boot. If none exist, transcription stops with an error — audio is never sent somewhere else. See the official site.'
strings.discStep2Byok: '· An engine you configured with your own key: audio goes to that provider under their privacy policy, with your credentials. Through the cloud it still passes our relay (in memory, never stored); on your own network we are not in the path.'
strings.discStep2Cloud: '· The built-in cloud engine: audio streams through our relay to be transcribed, today by Soniox; if they are unavailable we may switch this step back to speech-recognition servers we operate. Switching is an operator action — never mid-sentence. Audio stays in memory only, never written to disk.'
strings.discStep2Local: '· A local engine: nothing leaves your own hardware at this step — that is about your voice; where the text goes next is step 3. (You supply the speech model for the built-in engine yourself; it downloads one over the internet only if you explicitly set FLOWMIC_SHERPA_AUTO_DOWNLOAD=1 on the computer.)'
strings.discStep3Body: 'Translate and Organize always use a language model. Realtime sends each recording\'s closing transcript — including Record-only — only while AI polish is on. That switch lives under Settings → Speech recognition on your computer — this phone does not have it. The platform model is DeepSeek, on our account; we retain neither input nor output. See the official site.'
strings.discStep4Body: 'Text is delivered to the paired computer and typed into the focused box, via your own network or our cloud relay (which passes frames on and forgets them). See the official site.'
strings.discStep4LanPlain: '⚠️ Whether the local-network route is encrypted depends on how the pairing was made. A QR pairing is encrypted when the code carries the identity of the computer; your phone checks it on every later connection. Pairings created before that are still in the clear — pairing again upgrades one. Which this connection is, is under “Connection encryption”. Setting FLOWMIC_LAN_TLS to 0 on the computer turns this off: already-paired phones can no longer connect; recover by deleting the computer on the phone and pairing again.'
strings.discStep4Title: '4. Delivered to your PC and typed into the focused box'
strings.discStep5Body: 'We do not store transcripts: that table was deleted. The timeline lives on your phone and computer, and both can export it. We store your account, paired devices, synced settings, and monthly usage totals (minutes and tokens — never the content). See the official site.'
